rule: An older customer.subscription.updated (active) must not overwrite the later customer.subscription.deleted (canceled)
invariant: SELECT status <> 'active' FROM subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id='sub_1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: UPDATE subscriptions SET status='active', stripe_event_created=2000 WHERE stripe_subscription_id='sub_1' AND (stripe_event_created IS NULL OR stripe_event_created <= 2000)
UPDATE subscriptions SET status='canceled', stripe_event_created=3000 WHERE stripe_subscription_id='sub_1' AND (stripe_event_created IS NULL OR stripe_event_created <= 3000)
